title: FYLO app folder format marker (DRAFT, ADR 0033, not yet built)
description: Describes <drive>/<app>/.fylo/format.json. Written once when FYLO creates the app folder. A folder without it is not a FYLO app folder (ENOTFYLOROOT).

createdBy.description: The FYLO version that created the app folder, for example 26.50.02.

probe.description: The file-system probe result recorded at creation (ADR 0033 section 6). Every open checks that the recorded way still works, or refuses with EFSPROBE.

metadata.description: xattr: extended attributes (Windows: NTFS alternate data streams). sidecar: hidden .<payload>.fylo-attrs files beside each payload.

hardLinks.description: false: transaction before-images are copied instead of linked.
